name: fstatat64
synopsis: int fstatat64(int dirfd, const char *restrict pathname, struct stat *restrict statbuf, int flags);
description: fstatat64 is the underlying system call for fstatat, which retrieves file status information for a specified path relative to a directory file descriptor. It provides a more general interface for accessing file information, allowing control via flags for behaviors like symbolic link handling.

parameters.name: dirfd
parameters.description: Directory file descriptor or AT_FDCWD for resolving relative paths

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file for which to retrieve status

parameters.name: statbuf
parameters.description: Pointer to a stat structure to store the file information

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to modify behavior, such as AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: Search permission is denied for one of the directories in the path prefix of pathname
fd is not a valid open file descriptor
pathname is relative but dirfd is neither AT_FDCWD nor a valid file descriptor
Too many symbolic links encountered while traversing the path
A component of pathname does not exist or is a dangling symbolic link
pathname is an empty string and AT_EMPTY_PATH was not specified in flags
A component of the path prefix of pathname is not a directory
pathname is relative and dirfd is a file descriptor referring to a file other than a directory
pathname or fd refers to a file whose size, inode number, or number of blocks cannot be represented in the respective types

bugs: Different fields in the stat structure may contain information from different moments during execution, potentially leading to inconsistencies in the returned data.
